description: Set what a shared vault copies: one of the strategies measured on the time compressor (or "none" to stand aside), the book desk that trades it (its attribution on the Taifoon book; leave it out while the strategy has no desk and the vault stands aside), the ratio of that desk's position the vault holds, the most it may trade in one pass, and the markets. The vault's mirror reads this and brings the vault's venue account to desk position x ratio. Only the vault's administrators may set it (the house: people and the house agents acting for them); every mandate is kept, newest first.

desk.description: the book attribution of the desk that trades it (optional)

max_usd_per_pass.description: the most the mirror may trade in one pass

ratio.description: the share of the desk's position the vault holds: in (0, 1] on a mainnet outlet, up to 10 on a devnet vault (a devnet desk trades 5 USD, the venue's smallest order is 10)

strategy.description: a measured strategy id (strategies on the vault room's chooser) or "none"

vault.description: the shared vault's id or address

name: vault_copy
